name: IC Power Linear Regulator — 3.3V, 5V, LDO — MSOP
description: Surface-mount LDO linear regulator ICs in MSOP-8 packaging for 3.3V and 5V power applications.
selection_hints: Selecting 3.3V or 5V low dropout (LDO) linear regulators in MSOP packaging.
Designing SMD PCBs requiring MSOP-8 footprints with 0.65mm pitch.
Using LP2987 or LP2988 series linear regulator ICs.
avoid_when: Designs requiring through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
Layouts requiring footprints other than MSOP-8 (3x3mm, 0.65mm pitch).
Voltage regulator requirements other than 3.3V or 5V LDO.
